entities.name: Mirari Saga
entities.description: Set of storylines in the aftermath of the Weatherlight Saga, telling of the devastation caused by the Mirari.

entities.name: Weatherlight Saga
entities.description: Earlier storyline preceding the Mirari Saga.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: Powerful artifact created by Karn as a probe and sent to Dominaria, where it caused massive havoc on Otaria.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Creator of the Mirari who later retrieved it and took it to his artificial plane.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane to which the Mirari was sent.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria devastated by the Mirari.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Mirari granted sentience by Karn and put in charge of Karn's artificial plane.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: Featured event of the Mirari Saga.

entities.name: Corruption of Memnarch
entities.description: Featured event of the Mirari Saga.
